verdict.rationale: Wise exposes building blocks that let a user wire up their own background automations: a payments API, webhook subscriptions at application and profile level, batch transfer groups, bulk settlement, and rule-based card spend controls. However, the evidence shows no native automation feature; any autonomous workflow has to be custom-built on top of the API by the user. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring automations, a trigger/action automation builder, agent-driven background execution, and independent or hands-on evidence of automations running autonomously.
